import re, math
from collections import Counter

def tokenize(text):
    return re.findall(r"[a-zA-Z0-9'%$./-]+", text.lower())

def ngrams(tokens, n):
    return [tuple(tokens[i:i+n]) for i in range(len(tokens)-n+1)]

def rouge_n(ref, hyp, n):
    r = Counter(ngrams(ref, n)); h = Counter(ngrams(hyp, n))
    ov = sum((h & r).values())
    if ov == 0: return (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
    p = ov / max(1, sum(h.values())); rec = ov / max(1, sum(r.values()))
    f = 2*p*rec/(p+rec)
    return (p, rec, f)

def rouge_l(ref, hyp):
    m, n = len(ref), len(hyp)
    dp = [[0]*(n+1) for _ in range(m+1)]
    for i in range(1, m+1):
        for j in range(1, n+1):
            dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1]+1 if ref[i-1]==hyp[j-1] else max(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1])
    lcs = dp[m][n]
    if lcs == 0: return (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
    p = lcs/n; rec = lcs/m; f = 2*p*rec/(p+rec)
    return (p, rec, f)

def bleu(ref, hyp, max_n=4):
    precs = []
    for n in range(1, max_n+1):
        r = Counter(ngrams(ref, n)); h = Counter(ngrams(hyp, n))
        ov = sum((h & r).values())
        precs.append(ov / max(1, sum(h.values())))
    if any(p == 0 for p in precs) or len(hyp) == 0:
        geo = 0.0
    else:
        geo = math.exp(sum(0.25*math.log(p) for p in precs))
    bp = min(1.0, math.exp(1 - len(ref)/len(hyp))) if len(hyp) > 0 else 0.0
    return bp * geo

def stat(text):
    words = tokenize(text)
    sents = len(re.findall(r'[.!?](?:\s|$)', text))
    return len(words), sents

article = open('article.txt').read()
answers = {
    'GPT-4': open('gpt4_answer.txt').read(),
    'Claude': open('claude_answer.txt').read(),
}
ref = tokenize(article)

# Try to use official libraries if available for cross-check
try:
    from rouge_score import rouge_scorer
    scorer = rouge_scorer.RougeScorer(['rouge1','rouge2','rougeL'], use_stemmer=True)
    official = True
except Exception:
    official = False

for name, ans in answers.items():
    hyp = tokenize(ans)
    r1 = rouge_n(ref, hyp, 1); r2 = rouge_n(ref, hyp, 2); rl = rouge_l(ref, hyp)
    b = bleu(ref, hyp)
    wc, sc = stat(ans)
    print(f"== {name} ==")
    print(f"  words={wc} sentences={sc}")
    print(f"  ROUGE-1 P/R/F: {r1[0]:.3f}/{r1[1]:.3f}/{r1[2]:.3f}")
    print(f"  ROUGE-2 P/R/F: {r2[0]:.3f}/{r2[1]:.3f}/{r2[2]:.3f}")
    print(f"  ROUGE-L P/R/F: {rl[0]:.3f}/{rl[1]:.3f}/{rl[2]:.3f}")
    print(f"  BLEU: {b:.3f}")
    if official:
        s = scorer.score(article, ans)
        print(f"  [official rouge_score] r1F={s['rouge1'].fmeasure:.3f} r2F={s['rouge2'].fmeasure:.3f} rLF={s['rougeL'].fmeasure:.3f}")

# Key-fact coverage check
facts = {
    '33.7% efficiency': '33.7',
    'perovskite': 'perovskite',
    '20% cost reduction': '20%',
    'China 80% mfg': '80%',
    'IRA / $50B': 'inflation reduction act',
    'floating solar': 'floating solar',
    'offshore wind': 'offshore',
    'Dogger Bank / 3.6 GW': 'dogger',
    '15 MW turbines': '15-megawatt',
    '260m rotors': '260-meter',
    '$50-60/MWh offshore': '$50-60',
    '$30-40/MWh onshore': '$30-40',
    '150 GWh storage': '150 gwh',
    'LFP batteries': 'lfp',
    'sodium-ion': 'sodium-ion',
    'iron-air': 'iron-air',
    '$3-4/kg hydrogen': '$3-4',
    '$500B investment': '$500 billion',
    '14M jobs': '14 million',
    '23% carbon pricing': '23%',
    '2050 net-zero': '2050',
    'grid infrastructure': 'grid infrastructure',
}
print("\n== Key-fact coverage ==")
for name, ans in answers.items():
    low = ans.lower()
    covered = [k for k, v in facts.items() if v in low]
    print(f"{name}: {len(covered)}/{len(facts)} -> {covered}")
EOF
